newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin bans loan guarantees for tax delinquents.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin bans loan guarantees for tax delinquents.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin has prohibited the government from providing guarantees on foreign credits to companies which are not paying taxes, Russian news agencies quoted him as saying on Wednesday.
Yeltsin said the government would be open in providing guarantees otherwise, Itar-Tass said.
The Russian government is putting pressure on tax debtors to pay up and tax revenues in June were running at budgeted levels.
Low tax revenues prompted the International Monetary Fund to delay paying out several tranches of its $10 billion loan to Russia over the past 12 months.
